name: per_tensor_calibrate
description: Per-tensor Tessera calibration. --fitness selects the search mode: lrq (low-rank weight-scaling), awq (delegate to awq-evolve.py), flrq (factorized low-rank), dartquant (pre-rotation via QR-Orth + Whip loss), compare (run both and write a side-by-side report). Writes a per-tensor calibration policy JSON consumable by llama-quantize --tessera-policy.

layers.description: Directory of layer .npz bundles or a single .npz file. Optional when the per-component flags (--trunk-npz / --dflash-npz / ...) are set.

max_tokens.description: Maximum calibration tokens per bundle (default 256; 0 disables).

lrq_agg.description: How to aggregate the rank-r S matrix to a per-input-channel scale.

dartquant_whip_weight.description: Weight of the Whip loss (activation uniformity) in the combined fitness (default 0.1).

seed.description: Seed for both LRQ and AWQ legs.

flrq_rank_candidates.description: FLRQ rank sweep; the smallest rank whose relative reconstruction MSE clears --flrq-mse-threshold wins.

flrq_mse_threshold.description: FLRQ relative-MSE threshold for rank selection (default 0.001).

flrq_n_projections.description: FLRQ R1-Sketch Gaussian projection count (16-64 typical).

flrq_qbits.description: FLRQ residual quantisation bit-widths to sweep.

chunk_rows.description: Rows per chunk for out-of-core calibration.

peak_rss_budget_gb.description: Memory budget in GiB; the calibrator chunks below this.

spatial_occupancy.description: Spatial occupancy strategy for the calibration chunks.

temporal_pipeline_depth.description: Depth of the async temporal pipeline (auto/on/off fan-out).

async_io.description: Async I/O mode for the bundle reader.

model_role.description: Component role for this calibration pass.

tensor_stats_source.description: Which tensor_stats source the calibrator reads from.

backfill_tensor.description: If set, only re-calibrate the named tensor.

backfill_family.description: If set, only re-calibrate the named family.

backfill_sample_cap.description: Per-tensor sample cap for the backfill re-capture.

backfill_domains.description: Domain filter for the backfill corpus.

backfill_corpus.description: Path to a backfill-specific corpus directory.

backfill_db.description: DB to read backfill targets from (defaults to --db).

model_hash.description: Model hash stamped on every row.
